summary: Three actors enter the radar: Converge, Brindle and RakiDelmoro/Loom. Market movement reinforces Git-hiding orchestrators, stronger publication, recovery and authority handling, and richer provenance or context systems. No observed change demonstrates the full Ruu outcome. The strongest remaining discriminators are continuous eager convergence while producers remain active, exact in-flight dependencies on active producers, and global multi-repository convergence without caller-managed choreography. Absence of observed evidence is not proof of absence of capability.

findings.title: Merge bypass authority
findings.observed_change: Trail Merge authority handling was changed so requester authorization governs merge_with_bypass and mergeability or authorization is rechecked around the operation.
findings.guarantee_effect: Observed authority, presented result and authorized action align more faithfully; this is R8 and R9-like improvement.
findings.remaining_gap: It does not establish autonomous convergence or remove explicit Trail merge topology.
findings.next_investigation: Entire: Determine whether Trails evolve from explicit merge and publish transitions into globally managed exact intermediate version state.

findings.title: Local agent sandbox GA
findings.observed_change: GitHub announced filesystem, network, credential and service isolation plus policy enforcement for local Copilot agent sessions; MXC was mentioned as cross-platform enforcement.
findings.remaining_gap: No Ruu zero-preflight authoring, continuous convergence, exact dependency or multi-repository fixed point was demonstrated.
findings.next_investigation: GitHub: Track whether stacked-PR and agent orchestration evolves from branch-topology automation toward hidden exact version-state progression.

findings.title: Stacked PR GA confirmation
findings.observed_change: The 2026-10-06 announcement described stack rebase improvements, conditional approval preservation, signed replacements, merge-queue grouping, retargeting and automation.
findings.remaining_gap: The event predates the report window and is confirmation or new evidence, not window-local implementation change; stack topology remains.
findings.next_investigation: GitHub: Track whether stacked-PR and agent orchestration evolves from branch-topology automation toward hidden exact version-state progression.

findings.title: Code search
findings.observed_change: SQLite or FTS-style indexing, code graph, hybrid search and agent search tools were added.
findings.remaining_gap: This is not autonomous concurrent Git-state convergence.
findings.next_investigation: Atlas: Determine whether richer session and code intelligence becomes authoritative input for version coordination or remains adjacent context infrastructure.

findings.title: Session discovery
findings.observed_change: Terminal-started agent sessions can be discovered and some duplicate resumes avoided while a session is active.
findings.remaining_gap: This is not autonomous concurrent Git-state convergence.
findings.next_investigation: Atlas: Determine whether richer session and code intelligence becomes authoritative input for version coordination or remains adjacent context infrastructure.

findings.title: Converge admission
findings.observed_change: A Cloudflare-based prototype coordinates declared changes and assumptions into exact Git candidates, merges, checks, repair and approval paths with Durable Object or SQLite-style authority, fencing, a Git broker, isolated containers and hash-addressed evidence.
findings.guarantee_effect: Substantial intent-aware integration and authority primitives were established.
findings.remaining_gap: Documentation establishes one active mutating session per project; parallel agents within it do not demonstrate open continuous convergence of independent producers. Semantic incompatibility detection remains Development-System capability unless it replaces versioning responsibility.
findings.next_investigation: Converge: Test or inspect whether a producer can create an authoritative intermediate checkpoint, continue working, and have concurrent producers consume and reconcile against it without closing the mutating session.

findings.title: Brindle admission
findings.observed_change: Multiple agents work in isolated worktrees and branches under a supervisor; validations run, a reviewer validates an exact SHA and branch merge follows system conditions.
findings.remaining_gap: Explicit worktree and branch lifecycle remains internally and R4, R6 and R7 equivalence was not established.
findings.next_investigation: Brindle: Inspect what happens when an agent continues after a first exact validated checkpoint; determine whether later branches or checkpoints can interleave without batch completion or user ordering.

findings.title: Stale validation cancellation
findings.observed_change: Obsolete validation can be cancelled after branch HEAD movement or an existing verdict and the executor slot can be released.
findings.remaining_gap: Cancelling stale validation is not complete R5 reconciliation of stale authored version state.
findings.next_investigation: Brindle: Inspect what happens when an agent continues after a first exact validated checkpoint; determine whether later branches or checkpoints can interleave without batch completion or user ordering.

findings.title: RakiDelmoro/Loom admission
findings.observed_change: Public material established a Git-native multi-agent engine with isolated worktrees, parallel scheduler, commit, diff and rollback mechanics, Bench, Tuner, specialized roles and performance optimization.
findings.guarantee_effect: Relevant orchestration and downstream intelligence were established.
findings.remaining_gap: No R4, R6 or R7 equivalence was established; identity remains distinct from valkor-loom and rjwalters-loom.
findings.next_investigation: Inspect continuous interleaving and exact dependency behavior.

findings.title: Workspace branch creation
findings.observed_change: Desktop workflow centralized or simplified workspace switching before branch creation.
findings.remaining_gap: Branch and stack semantics did not disappear.
findings.next_investigation: Track whether topology disappears from ordinary use.

positioning_implications: You manage intent. Ruu manages versions.

The threat path is: orchestrator hides Git, users stop thinking about branch or worktree topology, the orchestrator strengthens stale-state, recovery and publication guarantees, and may approach autonomous versioning.
Ruu should not position only as better multi-agent Git.
R4 continuous eager convergence, R6 exact in-flight dependencies and R7 global invoke-anywhere multi-repository fixed point remain strongest discriminators.
Cloud differentiators remain multi-host authority, shared exact in-flight availability, canonical Team Development State, local correctness under Cloud outage and provider-independent team state.
